The production rule (scripts/deployment-guard/lib/sql-member-stakeholder-production-apply.mjs, sql79) requires current_user to be expected_table_owner and authenticated not to be a member of it (recursive pg_auth_members, INHERIT FALSE and SET FALSE included) before; after, both tables' owner is still it and equals current_user, authenticated is still not a member, both tables' ACLs (every entry, the owner's own included) are unchanged, and the policies on the two tables are the ones before plus exactly the four aws_member_* policies (permissive, INSERT or DELETE, to authenticated). These reads sit beside the fingerprint, so d9bc8921… and 878d6441… are unchanged.
